## Full-day workshop agenda

Source basis: [Slow AI Kitchen](https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen)

Canonical 09:00 to 17:00 agenda. Use a real business problem and produce an artifact. Authorize the training environment first; an authorized trainer supervises practice. Independent operation follows verified competence.

| **Time** | **Session** | **Evidence to collect** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 09:00 to 09:20 | Opening and purpose | Shared task and roles |
| 09:20 to 10:15 | Foundations instruction, Steps 1 to 3 | Explain human framing and acceptance |
| 10:15 to 11:00 | Exercise 1 | W03 brief, W08 DoD, W09 first pass |
| 11:00 to 11:15 | Break |  |
| 11:15 to 12:00 | Governance instruction, Steps 4 to 6 | Context, boundaries, accountability |
| 12:00 to 13:00 | Lunch |  |
| 13:00 to 13:45 | Exercise 2 | W05 context, W10 authority, AI draft |
| 13:45 to 14:15 | Execution instruction, Steps 7 to 9 | Build, verify and authorize release |
| 14:15 to 15:00 | Exercise 3 | Versioned artifact, W13 validation and decision |
| 15:00 to 15:15 | Break |  |
| 15:15 to 16:00 | Organizational deployment instruction | Registry, brigade and review cycle |
| 16:00 to 16:40 | Exercise 4 | W06 draft registry, W04 roles, W18 cadence |
| 16:40 to 17:00 | Decision presentations and close | Post-action review and next steps |

Workshop outputs: task brief; DoD; first-pass notes; context/risk map; AI draft; accountability record; validated final artifact; post-action review; draft registry entry; brigade matrix; audit/review-cycle design. Keep validation evidence and release authorization separately identifiable.
